source_manifest_reference: AUDIT_UPDATE_MANIFEST_2026-08-17.md (narrative only; machine-readable changed-file inventory missing)

items.intent: Accept valid controlled decisions without narrative false positives
items.rationale: Constrained first-line parsing preserves the gate and accepts limited Markdown formatting.
items.follow_up_trigger: Regression test failure or marker-contract change

items.source_item: Pepper and Jarvis as permanent controlled roles
items.intent: Stable executive and technical stewards who keep the founder oriented
items.rationale: The earlier overlap concern was later resolved through explicit user direction, bounded role instructions, canonical registration, KPI coverage, identity and communication-signature controls.
items.protected_outcome: Clear authority and bounded executive coordination
items.verification_reference: Role registry, identity/signature validators and role-loader test
items.follow_up_trigger: Role-overlap KPI or authority-boundary finding

items.intent: Simpler role and model loading
items.rationale: The replacement removes controlled paths, persona/KPI injection, capsule locations and fail-closed lane resolution.
items.protected_outcome: Configuration integrity and safe role/model loading
items.follow_up_trigger: Measured maintainability defect in the authoritative loader

items.intent: Create and validate external project workspaces
items.rationale: The replacement weakens containment, manifest invariants and learning-export boundaries.
items.follow_up_trigger: A project type cannot satisfy the current workspace contract

items.intent: Visible KPI and cost assessment
items.rationale: The replacement removes reserve forecasting and complete role-KPI coverage.
items.protected_outcome: Balanced, role-complete KPI and cost governance
items.follow_up_trigger: Comparable work shows a missing decision metric

items.intent: Observe model performance and adjust routing
items.rationale: The replacement removes append-only evidence, admission thresholds, route safeguards and human escalation.
items.follow_up_trigger: Approved model-observation requirement not covered by the current record

items.source_item: second Indo-German handoff schema and validator
items.intent: Machine-validate cross-border handoffs
items.rationale: The authoritative contract already has a validator and baseline test; parallel casing and rules would split the contract.
items.follow_up_trigger: Authoritative contract migration to one declared JSON schema

items.intent: Restrict access to sensitive information
items.rationale: Role-title access was replaced by purpose, scope, owner, independent approval, expiry and revocation.
items.protected_outcome: Least privilege and separation of duties
items.follow_up_trigger: Technical enforcement integration or access-policy change

items.intent: Give Pepper and the founder a current cross-functional brief
items.rationale: Unsupported mutable company state was replaced by a read-only evidence projection.
items.follow_up_trigger: Controlled source integration becomes available

items.intent: Adapt task size and parallelism from delivery evidence
items.rationale: Silent threshold mutation was replaced by a non-mutating recommendation and controlled micro-trial.
items.follow_up_trigger: Three comparable accepted packages support a bounded trial

items.intent: Assess process maturity and expose missing evidence
items.rationale: Manufactured maturity levels were replaced by a framework-specific evidence review defaulting to NOT_ASSESSED.
items.follow_up_trigger: Named framework/version and independent assessment scope exist

items.source_item: generic BIM and construction automation suite
items.intent: Automate recurring built-environment analysis and documentation
items.rationale: Unsafe product-specific executors were replaced by a common fail-closed capability admission contract while concrete adapters remain separate.
items.protected_outcome: Reusable automation without unsupported professional claims
items.follow_up_trigger: Named adapter use case, sources, fixtures, dependencies and qualified reviewer exist

items.source_item: regex IFC parser and generic BIM checker
items.intent: Validate IFC semantics and information requirements
items.rationale: Regex STEP parsing is unreliable; the capability remains required through an IFC-aware library, declared schema, IDS and BCF path.
items.follow_up_trigger: Approved IFC library/version, IDS fixture set, licence/security review and independent BIM acceptance

items.intent: Extract and compare Sweet Home 3D project information
items.rationale: Silent geometry defaults and unverified schema assumptions threaten model preservation; the use case remains required.
items.follow_up_trigger: Backed-up hashed fixtures, versioned schema evidence, preservation tests and live human acceptance

items.intent: Compare survey or point-cloud state with design state
items.rationale: Bounding-box slope ignores CRS, registration, ground classification, outliers and survey accuracy; a qualified adapter remains useful.
items.follow_up_trigger: CRS-aware fixture, registration/accuracy evidence, domain library and qualified survey review

items.intent: Produce traceable cost structures and exports
items.rationale: Embedded categories, tax, reserve and greenfield assumptions are not portable to Serbian or other jurisdictions.
items.follow_up_trigger: Jurisdiction, taxonomy/version, quantities, price source/date, tax and estimate class are approved

items.intent: Generate and coordinate construction sequences
items.rationale: Universal greenfield sequences and durations conflict with existing buildings, resources, constraints and uncertainty.
items.follow_up_trigger: Project context, dependencies, calendars, resources, duration sources and uncertainty are available

items.source_item: site log with suitability and payment conclusions
items.intent: Create structured site observations and escalation inputs
items.rationale: The diary intent is retained while legal, payment, acceptance and professional conclusions are prohibited without authority.
items.verification_reference: Built-environment capability tests and site-log contract
items.follow_up_trigger: A project activates a controlled site-log implementation

items.intent: Estimate solar/environmental performance
items.rationale: Decision-grade output requires location, weather, geometry, orientation, shading, engine/version, period and uncertainty.
items.follow_up_trigger: Approved analysis question, weather/geometry sources, engine and validation cases exist

items.intent: Detect controlled model and drawing changes
items.rationale: Room-name matching loses duplicates and cannot cover geometry, stable IDs or semantics.
items.follow_up_trigger: Stable-ID strategy, baseline/revision hashes, tolerances, semantic fields and duplicate fixtures exist

items.intent: Generate controlled project documents efficiently
items.rationale: Subprocess execution, unescaped content and mixed project assumptions require skill and dependency admission.
items.follow_up_trigger: Named publishing use case, pinned tool/template, escaping tests, source manifest and output validation exist

items.source_item: unverified Ralja KPI and lessons templates
items.intent: Feed project experience back into Corp improvement
items.rationale: The submitted files contain unverified product claims; importing them would contaminate company evidence.
items.follow_up_trigger: Validated project-owned KPI_Export.json and Lessons_Learned.json become available

items.intent: Make roles familiar and recognisable over time
items.rationale: Names are stable fictional work identities and do not change authority.
items.protected_outcome: Human-friendly continuity with canonical audit identity
items.follow_up_trigger: Approved role addition or explicit name migration

items.intent: Make role contributions recognisable without caricature
items.rationale: Restrained cadence and recognition patterns are injected with the role and preserve formal identity.
items.follow_up_trigger: Role addition, collision or communication-effectiveness finding

items.intent: Prevent stale or temporally invalid approval use
items.rationale: The checks were accepted with a trusted evaluation-time parameter instead of trusting a timestamp inside the record.
items.follow_up_trigger: Identity-provider enforcement integration

items.source_item: strict capability source hash and classification checks
items.intent: Reject ambiguous evidence identity and data classes
items.rationale: Exact SHA-256 syntax and controlled classification values strengthen the existing capability contract.
items.follow_up_trigger: Hash algorithm or classification policy change

items.intent: Prove role Markdown, names and signatures are loaded together
items.rationale: The additive test was retained and strengthened against configured identity/signature content and path traversal.
items.follow_up_trigger: Role-loading contract change

items.source_item: complete machine-readable changed-file inventory for the current Antigravity package
items.intent: Prove that every external change received a disposition
items.rationale: The package has narrative manifests and reviewed capability groups but no complete machine-readable change inventory against a prior snapshot.
items.follow_up_trigger: Antigravity supplies a changed-file manifest or Configuration Manager creates and reconciles a frozen snapshot diff
